mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.member_id AS memberId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.status AS status, o.final_amount AS finalAmount, o.pickup_at AS pickupAt, o.created_at AS orderCreatedAt, o.updated_at AS orderUpdatedAt, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '연동 주문 상품' WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(product_name) ELSE CONCAT(MIN(product_name), ' 외 ', COUNT(*) - 1, '건') END FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ) AS representativeProductName, o.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM orders o WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.member_id AS memberId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.status AS status, o.final_amount AS finalAmount, o.pickup_at AS pickupAt, o.created_at AS orderCreatedAt, o.updated_at AS orderUpdatedAt, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '주문 케이크' WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(product_name) ELSE CONCAT(MIN(product_name), ' 외 ', COUNT(*) - 1, '건') END FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ) AS representativeProductName, o.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM orders o WHERE o.member_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.member_id AS memberId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.status AS status, o.final_amount AS finalAmount, o.pickup_at AS pickupAt, o.created_at AS orderCreatedAt, o.updated_at AS orderUpdatedAt, '주문 케이크' AS representativeProductName, o.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('IN_PRODUCTION', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'PICKED_UP') AND o.updated_at >= #{since} ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC LIMIT 50
